div.div: أُتِيَّةُ الجُرْحِ , (so in a copy of the M,) or ↓ أُتِّيَّتُهُ , (so in some copies of the K, and accord. to the TA,) or ↓ أَتْيَتُهُ , (so in other copies of the K,) and ↓ آتِيَتُهُ , (so in the M, and in some copies of the K,) or ↓ إِتِّيَتُهُ , (so in some copies of the K, and accord. to the TA,) or أَتِيَّتُهُ, (so in a copy of the K,) The matter which comes from the wound: (M, K:) from Aboo-'Alee. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
